# Jesús Jiménez Alcántara — jjalcantara.dev

Personal portfolio of Jesús Jiménez Alcántara, Backend Engineer specialized in Azure, .NET and cloud architecture.

## About

Backend Engineer at The Bubble Hub (April 2024 – Present), Málaga, Spain. Previously Technology and Security Consultant at Ernst & Young (2022–2024), specialized in SIEM engineering within a SOC.

Degree in Software Engineering (Universidad de Málaga, 7.51/10). Master's in Secondary Education (Universidad Internacional de Andalucía, 8.9/10).

Skills:
- Advanced: C#, Java, Azure Cloud, Docker, Python, ASP.NET, SQL, CosmosDB, MongoDB
- Intermediate: Kubernetes, JavaScript, React, Django, Spring, SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, ElasticSearch)
